assertions: Pinned pull event/namespace/attribute/text/reference transitions preserved over actual Span/Pad/UNO values.
Source-observed quirks retained and native JS hex conversion exhaustively classified over byte domain.
Ordinary copied input and borrowed views add no pointer/allocator/refcount/provider library.

stackDivergence.rationale: Task110 ports the complete logical xmlreader event parser over actual shared Span/Pad/OUString/UNO values. Browser construction binds the native URL/file mapping to a copied URL and supplied private byte copy; native open/mmap/close/destructor/OS errors are not implemented or claimed. All three text modes, event/output timing, scoped/default/unknown/legacy xsi namespaces, attributes, references, permissive names/DTD skipping and root termination follow the pinned source. Numeric byte offsets and actual Uint8Array/DataView replace pointer syntax without ownership/capacity/refcount machinery. Helper shards operate this actual reader through an erased state type, without a second object. Fields use TypeScript protected visibility for cross-file implementation and unused-private diagnostics; native private access, deleted-copy enforcement, debug assertions, invalid ranges, pointer/address/ABI/postmutation borrow behavior and native file I/O are excluded. Out-of-range invalid native accesses retain host DataView RangeError, not a promised native outcome. Native JS single-byte parseInt hex conversion is checked for all256bytes; the source hex accumulation omission/sentinel, normalized CDATA prefix markup and attribute CR global peek remain unchanged and are recorded as CALC-094..096. The native hex overflow check is unreachable after valid0..15 digits or invalid-sentinel break and is source-reviewed rather than reproduced as a dead throw. Source-backed tests, not compiled native differential/full configuration QA. Configmgr schema/backend/defaults, Calc document/grid/ODS integration remain pending. Existing Writer SAX/document XML remains shared separately, as upstream does. Nextfull111 then requestedpause after relevant repairs; no Writer-only repair.
